what_happened: While researching task 558 (conclusion-stage filing/handoff phrasing convention), found that issue-log.md's actual seed enum has grown to 17 classes, but four other call sites still cite a stale '15-class seed enum' figure: scripts/orchestrate-build-dispatch.sh:925, scripts/orchestrate-conclusion-aggregate.sh:16, context/contracts/phase-closure.md:208, and context/contracts/conclusion-stage.md:117. issue-record.sh itself and its own test already say 17-class correctly. Out of scope for task 558 (NON-GOALS excludes unrelated changes); recorded for a future follow-up.

suite_selection_select invoked with MULTIPLE paths at once returned the bare __FULL_SWEEP__ sentinel when only one of the two paths was unmapped, masking the three real suites the other path (context/contracts/conclusion-stage.md -> test-orchestrate-conclusion-{aggregate,backstop,roadmap}.sh) actually maps to. Authoring a per-phase Tier Justification from that combined output produced a false sentinel claim for the mapped phase. Remedy applied here: invoke the selector once per phase with that phase's own paths only. A per-path breakdown (or a loud refusal on mixed mapped/unmapped input) would make the hazard non-silent.

validate-artifact.sh's authoring-shape advisory scan caught a false __FULL_SWEEP__ sentinel claim in this plan's Phase 2 Tier Justification at plan-acceptance time, naming the three real suites suite_selection_select actually returns for context/contracts/conclusion-stage.md. The advisory fired exactly where plan-format.md says the fix belongs -- authoring time -- rather than at a downstream refusal, and cost one validator re-run plus one edit to correct.

Editing agent-system/extensions/core/context/contracts/conclusion-stage.md's prose (adding 6 lines in Phase 2) tripped Gate 3 doc-lint's index-entries.json line_count check (declared 500, actual 506) because that file is tracked by source-store index-entries.json. Fixed by updating the line_count field in agent-system/extensions/core/index-entries.json to 506 (generate-context-line-counts.sh --write cannot run from the source store per deploy-root-guard.sh, so the field must be hand-updated for a source-store-only edit).
git-commit-phase.sh dropped 'agent-system/extensions/core/index-entries.json' from a phase commit pathspec: not contained in this task's declared file_scope.
